title: Safety Signal Detection & PSUR Support
area: Signal detection, PSUR & safety report analysis
short: Screens safety databases for disproportionate drug–event combinations and drafts structured summaries to support signal assessment and PSUR writing.
symptom: Safety signals hide in thousands of case reports
ingredient: A signal screen and summary assistant for PV teams
directions: Connect the company safety database or public data. Get a prioritized list of potential signals with case series summaries for medical review.
problem: Pharmacovigilance teams must periodically review large case volumes for new or changing risks and summarize them in periodic safety reports, under strict timelines.
why: A missed signal delays label updates and risk minimization; manual case-series review is slow.
solution: Applies disproportionality statistics to case data, groups related MedDRA terms, compares with the known safety profile, and drafts case-series summaries and PSUR section inputs with references to the underlying cases.
limitations: Statistical signals are hypotheses, not proof of causality
Reporting biases affect spontaneous report data
review: Safety physicians and the QPPV assess every signal and approve periodic reports.
